summary: ReplayKit records screen video, app audio and microphone, and feeds live broadcasts. BifrOSt has no screen video recording and no SDK API for it; the only capture is a system microphone recorder used by Voice Memos, which apps cannot call through the SDK. Screenshots are still frames only.

gaps: No screen video recording for apps, the shell or the MCP tools (screen streams deliver one frame per event, sdk screen_stream.rs, and nothing encodes a movie).
No SDK API for recording: no RPScreenRecorder equivalent in springboard/sdk/src/.
Microphone recording (springboard/src/media/capture.rs) is not reachable from app SDK code; it is used by Voice Memos only.
No app or system audio capture; audiod does not loop back output.
No clip buffer, clip export, preview or trim UI.
No live broadcast extension point or broadcast picker.
